stories.title: Palworld is expanding to mobile with a new MMORPG
stories.summary: The team behind Palworld is bringing the breakout survival-crafting hit to mobile with a new MMORPG spinoff, according to The Verge. Details on the mobile title's scope and release timing haven't been disclosed beyond the announcement.
stories.whyItMatters: It's another sign of hit PC/console games chasing mobile's much larger audience to extend a franchise's reach and revenue.
whatToWatch: Official release window and supported platforms
How monetization will work compared to the original game
questions: Will it be a full MMORPG or a scaled-down mobile spinoff?
How will it monetize compared to the original release?

stories.title: Samsung bans smart TV apps that turn viewers into unwitting internet proxies
stories.summary: Samsung says it is banning smart TV apps that share users' internet connections with strangers, according to Engadget and TechCrunch. The move targets apps that apparently route outside traffic through people's home networks without clear consent.
stories.whyItMatters: It highlights how proxy-style schemes have crept into smart TV app ecosystems, pushing platform owners to police security and privacy risks more aggressively.
whatToWatch: Which apps get removed from Samsung's store
Whether other smart TV or streaming device makers follow suit
questions: How was this practice discovered and how widespread was it?
Will affected users be notified or compensated?

stories.title: Leaked images reveal a Lenovo 'Googlebook' laptop and 2-in-1 tablet
stories.summary: Leaks reported by The Verge show a Lenovo-made device referred to as a 'Googlebook,' apparently spanning both a laptop and a 2-in-1 tablet form factor. Neither Google nor Lenovo has confirmed the products.
stories.whyItMatters: A new Google-branded hardware line built with Lenovo would signal fresh competitive pressure in the laptop and tablet market.
whatToWatch: Official confirmation or announcement from Google or Lenovo
Specs, pricing, and launch timing once revealed
questions: What operating system will these devices run?
Is 'Googlebook' a product name or a leak codename?

stories.title: Cybersecurity startup Horizon3 hits $2B valuation with $250M Series E
stories.summary: Horizon3 has raised a $250 million Series E that values the autonomous security-testing company at $2 billion, TechCrunch reports. The round comes as the company positions itself against fast-evolving, AI-driven cyber threats.
stories.whyItMatters: The large raise signals strong investor confidence that AI is reshaping both offensive and defensive cybersecurity, a space enterprises are pouring money into.
whatToWatch: How Horizon3 deploys the new capital
Competitive responses from rival security-testing vendors
questions: Who led the round and which investors participated?
What specific AI threats is Horizon3 targeting with this funding?

stories.title: Base Power raises another $1B to grow its backyard battery grid network
stories.summary: Base Power has raised another $1 billion, according to TechCrunch, to expand its network of residential batteries that it says can help stabilize the power grid. The company has now raised significant capital in successive rounds for this buildout.
stories.whyItMatters: It reflects growing investment in distributed home battery storage as a way to ease strain on power grids facing rising electricity demand.
whatToWatch: Scale of new battery installations funded by this round
Any new utility or grid-operator partnerships
questions: How many homes or batteries will this funding add?
How does Base Power's model interact with existing utility demand-response programs?

stories.title: Microsoft is bringing Xbox 360 games to PC
stories.summary: Microsoft is bringing a selection of Xbox 360-era games to PC, The Verge reports. The move continues Microsoft's push to unify its gaming library across console and PC.
stories.whyItMatters: It further blurs the line between console and PC gaming for Microsoft, potentially boosting the value of its PC gaming and subscription offerings.
whatToWatch: Which specific Xbox 360 titles are included
Whether the games arrive via Game Pass or standalone purchase
questions: What's the full list of games coming to PC?
Will pricing or bundling favor Game Pass subscribers?

stories.title: SpaceX set to acquire 130,000 acres of Louisiana marshland
stories.summary: SpaceX is reportedly poised to acquire roughly 130,000 acres of marshland in southern Louisiana, according to Ars Technica. The report doesn't specify what SpaceX intends to build there.
stories.whyItMatters: A land acquisition of this scale suggests SpaceX may be planning major new infrastructure, echoing the kind of build-out it undertook around Starbase in Texas.
whatToWatch: Official confirmation from SpaceX of the acquisition and its purpose
Permitting activity or local/regulatory reaction in Louisiana
questions: What is the land intended for?
What environmental or regulatory hurdles could affect use of marshland?

stories.title: ChatGPT emerges as Congress's go-to AI tool
stories.summary: TechCrunch reports that ChatGPT has become the preferred AI tool among members of Congress. The report doesn't detail how officially or extensively it's being used across offices.
stories.whyItMatters: Which AI tool lawmakers actually use day-to-day can shape how they understand AI's capabilities and, eventually, how they choose to regulate it.

stories.title: Wispr Flow's updated terms hint at a coming meeting notetaker
stories.summary: TechCrunch reports that updated terms of service from voice AI startup Wispr Flow suggest the company is preparing to launch a meeting notetaker product. No official launch has been announced.
stories.whyItMatters: It would add another entrant to the increasingly crowded AI meeting-assistant market as voice AI startups look to expand beyond dictation tools.

How the notetaker differentiates from existing meeting AI tools
questions: When might this feature actually launch?

stories.summary: Engadget published its updated buying guide ranking the best wireless earbuds for 2026. As a roundup rather than a single news event, it reflects the current state of the earbuds market rather than one specific development.

stories.title: How car headlights got brighter, whiter, and more blinding

stories.whyItMatters: Headlight glare has become a recurring road-safety complaint, and the trend raises questions about whether automotive lighting design or regulation needs to catch up.
